card.name: Number words in titles and names
card.fires_on: A spelled-out number word such as Two, Three, Five, Seven or Four that opens a capitalized title or proper name, like a book, film, episode or place. The number is followed by a plural noun.

modes.label: Number in a work's title
modes.description: A number word begins the title of a book, film, play or episode.
modes.example: In<< Seven>> Samurai, the samurai display great perseverance

modes.label: Number in a place or group name
modes.description: A number word begins the name of a council, bay or organization.
modes.example: a leader of the Council of the<< Four>> Lands, built a synagogue in the name

card.writes: It favors continuations like fold, times, years and ways, which follow a number word.
card.plain: It marks a spelled-out number at the start of a title or name, such as Seven Samurai or Three Saints Bay.
